what_i_see: A white cylinder (stem) with a large red sphere behind/around it forming the mushroom cap, and a small white dot on top. The red cap and white stem clearly evoke a toadstool/fly agaric mushroom, though the cap reads more as a flat circle behind the stem rather than a domed cap sitting on top. The white dot on the cap is a nice touch referencing the classic spotted mushroom look.
